body: Screenshot: Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as User. 2.On Dashboard, go to "Homes near you" widget. 3.Click "Browse All Properties" link. 4.Lands on Discover Properties page (/user/dashboard/discover) with no filters applied (default: All Types, Relevance, Any Beds, Any Baths, no location/price entered — aside from a pre-filled Min/Max price range). 5.Observe results area. Expected Result: Search/Discover is the primary entry point for users to "find realistic options" and is the very first stage of the User Journey Map ("Explore → A clear shortlist"). Navigating here with no meaningful filters applied should show available listings (the dashboard itself claims 71 results exist), not zero. Actual Result: The Discover Properties page shows "No properties match your search" with a prompt to "Clear Filters," even though no explicit restrictive filter was set by the user (only a default Min/Max price range was pre-populated, and the dashboard just showed properties with prices). This breaks the core Search → Choose journey at the very first step.
title: "Browse All Properties" leads to Discover page returning zero results by default

body: Screenshot: User Flow – Dashboard – Homes Near You (Map Preview) Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as User. 2.Land on Dashboard. 3.View the "Homes near you" map widget. Expected Result: this widget exists to help the user find "possible homes" and give "a clear starting point" — implying the map should center/zoom on the user's actual location or search area with nearby listings visible. Actual Result: The map renders as a fully zoomed-out world map (showing all continents), with only 2 markers visible anywhere on the globe. This does not represent "homes near you" in any meaningful, localized sense.
title: "Homes near you" map is a fully zoomed-out world view, not a localized view

body: Screenshot: Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as Admin 2.Go to Fast Track → open case "Launch Rent 1774522500236" 3.On the "Selected" stage view, click the "Documents" tab in the stage navigation bar. Expected Result: Clicking between stage tabs (Selected → Documents → Viewing → etc.) should smoothly update the content in place, keeping the page position stable — the URL updates the section= param, so this is a client-side tab switch and shouldn't cause a jarring scroll/page shift. Actual Result: After clicking "Documents," the entire page pushes downward — the Active/Completed/Cancelled counters all shift lower on the screen instead of staying fixed, creating an abrupt, disorienting jump.
title: Page scrolls abruptly when switching Fast Track stage tabs

body: Screenshot:' Admin Flow – Verifications – User Entity – Verification Actions Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as Admin 2.Go to Verifications → User entity → open "Madhu Pavan" (Verified/Approved) 3.Scroll to "Verification approved" section at the bottom 4.Attempt to click "Revoke". Expected Result: UI's own instruction text ("Revoke this verification before approving it again"), Revoke should be an active, clickable action so admin can reverse an approval when needed. Actual Result: The "Revoke" button is disabled/non-functional, with no way to revoke the approval — making the documented revoke-then-reapprove workflow impossible to complete.
title: "Revoke" button disabled on Approved verification, blocking the required revoke-before-reapprove flow

body: Screenshot: Admin Flow – Verifications – Manager Profile Detail – Activity Log Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as Admin 2.Go to Verifications → Manager entity → open "Pavan Kumar Maddirala" (Rejected) 3.Expand "Activity Log" entry ("Manager Rejected," 3/7/2026, 1:23:17 am – system) Expected Result: The Activity Log should show a real, attributable audit event — e.g., which admin/system actor rejected it, when, and why — since this is meant to be the historical record of actions taken. Actual Result: The bottom status card correctly displays the rejection reason to the user. However, the Activity Log entry itself contains fallback text — "Status imported from the approved manager profile because no detailed audit history was returned" — indicating no real audit record exists for this action; it's a system-generated placeholder rather than a genuine logged event.
title: Activity Log entry does not record a genuine audit event — shows fallback/placeholder text instead

body: Screenshot: Admin Flow – Verifications – Manager Entity – View Toggle Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as Admin 2.Go to Verifications → Manager entity 4.Click the grid/box icon Expected Result: Clicking the grid icon should switch the applications list from list view to a card/grid layout. Actual Result: Nothing happens on click — the view stays in list mode, and the icon shows no active/selected state change.
title: Grid view toggle icon (left of the list-view icon) is not clickable

body: Screenshot: Admin Flow – Verifications – Manager Entity – Tab Navigation Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as Admin 2.Go to Verifications → switch to Manager entity 3.Click the "ARCHIVED" tab next to "ALL APPLICATIONS" Expected Result: Clicking "ARCHIVED" should switch the view to show archived manager verification applications, per standard tab behavior. Actual Result: Tab does not respond to click — no view change, no archived list loads.
title: "Archived" tab under Verifications (Manager) is not clickable

body: Screenshot: Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as Admin 2.Note Dashboard → Platform Health → "Pending Verifications: 0" 3.Navigate to Verifications → User tab 4.Observe stat cards: All Users 8, Pending 0, In Review 6, Approved 2 Expected Result: The dashboard should give admins an accurate at-a-glance signal of "what needs attention today." If 6 out of 8 users are sitting "In Review" (i.e., not yet Approved), the dashboard's headline verification metric should surface this as work awaiting admin action — not show 0. Actual Result: Dashboard shows "Pending Verifications: 0," implying nothing needs review, while the Verifications page shows 6 users still "In Review." An admin relying on the dashboard summary alone would incorrectly believe the verification queue is empty.
title: Dashboard "Pending Verifications: 0" doesn't reflect 6 users "In Review" on Verifications page

body: Screenshot: Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as Admin 2.Open Dashboard → Overview 3.Scroll to Platform Snapshot panel. Expected Result: Per the handbook, Fast Track/bookings are tied to real property transactions; Total Bookings (59) and Live Deals (59) should generally correlate with some non-zero Revenue figure, or the dashboard should clarify why revenue is zero (e.g., "no completed contracts yet"). Actual Result: Revenue displays ₹0 while Total Bookings = 59 and Live Deals = 59 Active fast-track flows, with no explanatory label distinguishing "bookings" from "closed/paid deals."
title: Revenue shows ₹0 despite 59 active bookings/live deals

body: Screenshot: Steps to Reproduce: 1.Log in as Admin 2.Open Dashboard → Overview 3.Compare "Quarterly Goals" summary text against "Active Listings" stat in Platform Snapshot. Expected Result: If 62 properties are verified/total, Active Listings should reasonably reflect a large subset of that (or the dashboard should clearly differentiate "Total Properties" vs "Verified" vs "Active/Live Listings" so the numbers don't appear contradictory). Actual Result: Quarterly Goals states "62 verified properties," Total Properties shows 62, but Active Listings shows only 4 — a >90% gap with no label explaining the difference (e.g., pending publish, inactive, rented out).
title: "62 verified properties" (Quarterly Goals) inconsistent with Active Listings count (4)

body:
# Ticket: Manual End-to-End Regression Test for Entire Estospaces Application

## Summary

Perform one complete manual end-to-end validation of the Estospaces application across all roles to confirm that the platform is usable, connected end to end, and ready for release.

This is a single QA ticket covering the full application experience for:
- Guest
- User
- Manager
- Admin

---

## Objective

Validate that the main product journeys work correctly from start to finish, including:
- authentication
- navigation
- property discovery
- broker request flow
- manager response flow
- property sharing and selection
- messaging
- applications
- viewings
- contracts
- payments
- notifications
- profile and settings
- admin oversight flows

---

## Roles in Scope

| Role | Validation Focus |
| --- | --- |
| Guest | Public pages, entry points, navigation to auth |
| User | Search, save, broker request, shortlist review, property selection, active journey |
| Manager | Live request handling, property shortlist sharing, follow-up workflows |
| Admin | Platform monitoring, users, properties, verifications, oversight pages |

---

## Test Scope

### 1. Guest / Public Experience

| Scenario | Expected Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Open landing page | Landing page loads correctly and looks polished |
| Open contact page | Contact page works and content is visible |
| Open FAQ page | FAQ page works and content is visible |
| Open privacy / terms / cookies pages | Legal pages open without layout or content issues |
| Open sign in and sign up entry points | Authentication entry points are easy to access |

### 2. Authentication Experience

| Scenario | Expected Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Sign in as user | Redirects correctly to user dashboard |
| Sign in as manager | Redirects correctly to manager dashboard |
| Sign in as admin | Redirects correctly to admin dashboard |
| Invalid login | Clear error is shown |
| Forgot password page | Opens correctly |
| Logout | Session ends correctly |
| Refresh after login | Session remains valid |
| Switch account | User can safely move between roles |

### 3. User Experience

| Scenario | Expected Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Open user dashboard | Dashboard loads correctly with working navigation |
| Browse buy journey | User can browse buy-related property content |
| Browse rent journey | User can browse rent-related property content |
| Search / discover properties | Discovery and search results work properly |
| Open property detail page | Property details are visible and complete |
| Save a property | Saved property appears correctly |
| Open saved / favorites area | Saved items are visible and usable |
| Create broker request | Request is created successfully |
| View live broker workspace | User can track the request clearly |
| Receive shared shortlist | Broker-shared properties appear correctly |
| Open shared property | Property opens correctly |
| Select shared property | Selected property becomes the active journey |
| Open messages | User can access conversation flow |
| Open applications | Applications page works |
| Open bookings | Bookings page works |
| Open viewings | Viewings page works |
| Open payments | Payments page works |
| Open contracts | Contracts page works |
| Open notifications | Notifications page works |
| Open profile | Profile page works |
| Open settings | Settings page works |
| Open help / support | Help page works |
| Re-login during active journey | User still sees the correct active flow |

### 4. Manager Experience

| Scenario | Expected Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Open manager dashboard | Dashboard loads correctly |
| Open live response area | Live request area is visible and understandable |
| Go live / available | Manager can become available for requests |
| Receive incoming request | Request appears correctly |
| Accept / respond to request | Request can be handled successfully |
| Open matched workspace | Matched client workspace appears correctly |
| Open properties list | Inventory page loads correctly |
| Add property | Property creation works if needed |
| Edit property | Existing property can be updated |
| View property detail | Property detail page opens correctly |
| Shortlist properties for user | Manager can prepare relevant options |
| Share shortlist | Shortlist is successfully shared to the user |
| Update shortlist | Manager can revise shortlist if needed |
| Confirm selected property | Manager can identify what the user selected |
| Open leads | Leads page works |
| Open applications | Applications page works |
| Open appointments | Appointments page works |
| Open messages | Messaging works |
| Open contracts | Contracts page works |
| Open analytics | Analytics page works |
| Open billing | Billing page works |
| Open clients | Clients page works |
| Open notifications | Notifications page works |
| Open help | Help page works |
| Open verification pages | Verification-related screens work |

### 5. Admin Experience

| Scenario | Expected Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Open admin dashboard | Admin dashboard loads correctly |
| Open users page | Users page works |
| Open properties page | Properties page works |
| Open property detail | Property detail opens correctly |
| Open verifications | Verification management works |
| Open analytics | Analytics page works |
| Open fast-track area | Fast-track oversight page works |
| Open notifications | Notifications page works |
| Open profile | Profile page works |
| Open settings | Settings page works |
| Open reviews | Reviews page works |
| Open chat | Chat page works |

---

## Cross-Role End-to-End Validation

| Journey | Expected Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| User creates broker request -> manager receives it | Request is visible on both sides |
| Manager accepts request -> user sees matched state | Matched state is clear and consistent |
| Manager shares shortlisted properties -> user receives them | Shared properties appear in the correct workspace |
| User opens and reviews shared properties | Shared property presentation is clean and usable |
| User selects one shared property | Selected property becomes the active journey property |
| User continues into the next stage | Journey remains connected to that property |
| User and manager exchange messages | Same conversation is visible from both sides |
| Viewings / applications / contracts / payments remain connected | Follow-up pages reflect the same active journey |
| Refresh and re-login do not break state | Journey remains intact after refresh or sign-in again |

---

## UX / Visual Validation

| Scenario | Expected Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Dashboard layouts | Clean, aligned, readable |
| Property cards and property detail pages | Strong hierarchy and no broken layout |
| Broker-shared property presentation | Easy to read, easy to act on, no cramped layout |
| Forms and actions | Clear buttons, labels, and validation |
| Modals and overlays | Open and close correctly |
| Empty states and loading states | Clear and not confusing |
| Navigation | Consistent across all roles |
| Responsive behavior | Core screens remain usable on common viewports |

---

## Expected Result

The full Estospaces application should support a complete manual journey across all roles without major blockers, broken pages, misleading states, or disconnected workflows.

---

## Definition of Done

This ticket is complete when:

1. All major role-based journeys have been manually tested.
2. All major cross-role flows have been validated.
3. Any failures are documented with page name, role, scenario, and screenshot.
4. A final QA outcome is recorded as one of:
   - Passed
   - Passed with minor issues
   - Failed / blocked

---

## QA Output Required

Please record the following in the ticket comments after execution:
- Overall result
- Failed scenarios, if any
- Blocking issues, if any
- Screenshots for visual or functional failures
- Notes on any inconsistent state between roles
